snippet.title: Slack School | Build Your First Slack App
snippet.description:
Ever wish Slack could do that one specific thing to make your team’s workday a little easier? Good news: you don’t need a computer science degree to make it happen. In this episode, we’ll show you how easy it is to build a custom Slack app. We’ll walk through setting up a bot, choosing its permissions, and creating custom slash commands to trigger quick actions. You'll also get a friendly introduction to reading app manifests using JSON. It’s a lot simpler than it sounds – promise. Class dismissed!

snippet.title: Slack | What Is a Work OS? (Explained in 60 Seconds)
snippet.description:
Switching between 10 different apps just to get one task done? A work OS can turn your chaotic workflow into a central hub. It’s an open, flexible platform that centralizes your people, projects, data, and knowledge in one place. 

Ready to find out what Slack can do for your team?
👉 Visit the Slack website to learn more: https://slack.com/

The Problem: App Fatigue
Most teams lose hours every week jumping between spreadsheets, chat apps, and project tools. Information gets buried, and productivity stalls.

The Solution: A Work Operating System
A work OS is like the connective tissue of your business. It’s an open, flexible platform that centralizes your people, projects, data, and knowledge in one place. No more hunting for files — just work happening where it should.

Key features include:
1. Central hub: Connect all your favorite apps (docs, CRM, dev tools) in one workspace and eliminate task-switching.
2. Automate the boring stuff: Build custom, no-code automations to handle repetitive tasks and set reminders to keep you on track.
3. Contextual collaboration: Discuss projects where you can easily bring in the data and files you need without hunting them down.

Powered by AI
With built-in AI, your work OS becomes a personal assistant that never sleeps:
1. Summarize: Get the gist of long threads or documents instantly.
2. Generate: Create content, project plans, or drafts in seconds.
3. Insights: Surface hidden data trends to make smarter decisions faster.

Stop managing your tools and start managing your work. 

Follow us for more tips on productivity, AI, and the future of work:
👉 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/tiny-spec-inc/ 
👉 Twitter/X: https://x.com/SlackHQ
👉 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/slackhq/

snippet.title: How to drive canvas adoption (and productivity) in Slack
snippet.description:
Here are some 5 best practices on how to drive adoption of canvases in Slack across your organization. 

0:17 What are canvases in Slack? 
0:42 Tip 1 - Use canvases for announcements 
1:18 Tip 2 - Find internal champions
1:41 Tip 3 - Keep training your team
2:01 Tip 4 - Use canvases in more areas
2:32 Tip 5 - Move slowly to move fast

Canvases are a tool to help teams organize and share information — completely connected to your Slack workspace. Create or edit a canvas using the Slack features you already know: more tips on that in some of our previous Slack canvas videos.

Canvases help you save time and boost productivity. But the real magic happens when your entire team and company embrace its potential. Here's how you can unlock the next level of effectiveness!

Learn more: https://slack.com/features/canvas

snippet.title: How to automate your work with Slack
snippet.description:
Workflow Builder is a tool in Slack that allows you to automate tasks without needing to know how to code. 

You can use it to create workflows that send messages, create forms, or integrate with other apps. 

0:11 - Why you need to automate your work
0:28 - What is Workflow Builder? 
0:42 - Things you should automate
0:54 - Step-by-step: build your 1st automation
3:53 - Best practices for automations

Here are some examples of common tasks you could automate with the workflow builder:
- Collecting and providing feedback 
- Requesting help including  IT, engineering or creative help
- Onboarding processes for new employees or partners 
- Prompting status updates such as for a big project

Let’s work together and create a workflow using Workflow Builder, showing you how to get started + some best practices. 

Happy automating! 

***

snippet.title: Home/Free | Official Trailer | Now Streaming on Prime Video
snippet.description:
The U.S. incarcerates people at a rate higher than any country in the world. What we don’t talk about enough is what happens when people come home from prison. Are they actually free?

Home/Free, a documentary short film series from Slack, Next Chapter, freeamerica and the Equal Justice Initiative, shares the personal stories of individuals who have returned home from prison in order to answer this urgent question. There are thousands of obstacles – including systemic barriers to building a secure, skilled career – that stand in the way of real freedom. Home/Free is available to stream on Prime Video:

United States: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BXMY555M
United Kingdom: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0BXMT9Y3K

Narrated by freeamerica founder John Legend, Home/Free sheds light on the many challenges faced by returning citizens, and asks what would be possible if we prioritized redemption and restoration, empowering those leaving incarceration with a real second chance. The full series will be released in late 2022.

For more information on how Next Chapter is building career pathways in tech for formerly incarcerated individuals, visit www.nextchapterproject.org or www.reworkreentry.org
